### The Word Became Flesh
Author: Ken Jones
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-word-became-flesh-december-2020
Passage: John 1:14
Points:
- The incarnation is a profound mystery, as the eternal divine Word took on limited human flesh.
- Christ demonstrates the true beauty of God's image expressed perfectly in human nature.
- Taking on flesh was necessary so Jesus could fulfill the Father's will and pay our sin debt.
- Jesus' physical resurrection provides believers with the living hope of future immortality.

### Enjoying His Fullness
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/enjoying-his-fullness
Passage: John 1:16
Points:
- The fullness supplying unending grace to believers is the infinite, divine fullness of God.
- By taking on human flesh, Christ made God's boundless fullness accessible to us.
- This fullness is uniquely mediated to us directly through the Father's only Son.
- Christ's inexhaustible grace enriches believers while remaining anchored in absolute truth.
